text:
kevin_support: Hey team, escalation from AcmeAI — customer sees intermittent 400 errors (InvalidEmbeddingDim) during bursts and tail latency spikes around the same time. They call out that most requests succeed but ~1-3% fail with a dim mismatch. Logs attached in the ticket. Can we triage?

jordan_cs: Adding context from customer: they're calling /v1/embeddings with model=embed-redwood-2-large and expect dim=1536. Payloads are small single-input requests, but when they send a burst we start to get 400: "Invalid embedding dimension: expected 1536 got 768". They also see some requests taking >2s while median is ~60ms.

maria_ops: Thanks. Any chance they're hitting a fallback/variant? We had a rollout last week that added a quantized small variant (embed-redwood-2-small -> 768 dim) for cheaper routing during capacity pressure. If routing mixes variants inside the same batch that could explain the mismatch.

ryan_infra: I pulled the runtime logs for the time window. I see dynamic-batcher coalescing single-request frames into larger batches. At 2026-03-16T14:02:12Z there was a capacity pressure event in eu-west-1 and the smart-router routed ~12% traffic to embed-redwood-2-small as fallback. Batcher then produced batches that contained requests pinned to both large and small variants. We have a guard but it's only applied at execution time in the backend, so it tried to run the batch and failed the dimension check for the small model when the client expected 1536. Logs: 

```
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z INFO batcher: coalesced batch_id=abc123 size=8 models_in_batch=[embed-redwood-2-large,embed-redwood-2-small]
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z ERROR executor: model-dim-mismatch batch_id=abc123 expected=1536 observed=768 request_ids=[r234,r235]
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z WARN router: fallback_route_used reason=burst_capacity customer=acmeai
```

elena_modelops: That's helpful. Two separate problems interleaving: (1) mixed-variant batches causing immediate 400 dim errors, and (2) tail latency from batcher waiting to fill/flush when fallback routing churns. We should prevent mixing incompatible variants in the same batch and make the error friendlier.

dyn-batcher-bot: Current batcher config for the affected pool: 
```
max_batch_size: 16
coalesce_window_ms: 12
allow_mixed_variants: true  # default for throughput
```

maria_ops: allow_mixed_variants=true is the root cause here. We enabled it during an internal perf test to maximize GPU utilization, but it assumes compatible embedding dims across variants (which is false here). Two-step proposal:
1) Immediately roll config change to disallow mixed variants for embeddings models (allow_mixed_variants=false). This will avoid dimension mismatches at the cost of slightly lower GPU packing.
2) Add a runtime pre-check that inspects model dims for a coalesced batch and rejects coalescing if dims don't match, returning a clearer 409 or a specialized code (instead of allowing execution to fail mid-run).

kevin_support: Customer-facing workaround suggested to AcmeAI: pin model to embed-redwood-2-large in request (model param) or set prefer_variant=true so router will not fall back. Also suggest lowering client parallelism to avoid mixing during their burst until we patch. They asked for exact curl to reproduce — I prepared a script.

jordan_cs: paste of repro curl that fails on their side when routed to mixed batch: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-redwood-2-large","input":["short text 1"]}'
# run 200 concurrent of the above with a small inter-request sleep to simulate burst
```

elena_modelops: For the engineering repro I'll spin up a synthetic load that uses a 90/10 split of large->small routing to force mixed batches. Also will instrument the batcher to log model_ids per batch more verbosely.

ryan_infra: Quick mitigation plan implemented: set allow_mixed_variants=false on eu-west-1 embedding pool, coalesce_window_ms=>8 (tighten), and emit a metric batcher.mixed_variant_rejected. Rolling now (should be live in 5m).

maria_ops: Followups: action items
- eng-runtime (elena): add pre-coalesce dim guard + clearer error message and return 409 code with message "Batch contains incompatible embedding dims: request rejected. Use model pin or disable mixed variants." (owner: elena, ETA: 2d)
- infra (ryan): temporary config change rolled to disallow mixed variants for embeddings in affected regions (done). Add a gated rollout for other regions. (ETA: today)
- support (kevin/jordan): share workaround and scheduled status update with AcmeAI; offer a short-term credit for disruption (owner: kevin, ETA: 1h)
- product: document routing/variants behavior in embeddings FAQ and add guidance about pinning for strict dim contracts. (owner: product-docs, ETA: 1w)

kevin_support: Customer replied — accepted workaround, saw immediate drop in errors after we pinned model and we tightened concurrency. They still want permanent fix timeline. I committed to the 2d ETA and will keep them posted.

jordan_cs: Notes for postmortem: this is an expected failure mode when enabling mixed-variant packing with non-homogeneous embedding dims. We should add an automated test in the batching harness that creates two variants with different dims and ensures we never coalesce them.

elena_modelops: Agreed. I'll add the test and the dim-guard hook. Also considering returning a diagnostic header X-Redwood-Batch-Profile that lists models_in_batch for easier triage.

maria_ops: Closing the Slack escalation. I'll update the ticket in Zendesk with the actions and give the customer the 2d ETA for runtime fix. :thumbsup:

kevin_support: Thanks all — good catch on the allow_mixed_variants flag. Keeping thread open until runtime change lands.
